title: Night Lighting Lock
description: A four-image reference-dependent package that locks the core spatial language of night architecture lighting photography set before controlled viewpoint and mood variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the canonical spatial language for Night Architecture. Images 02-04 depend on that reference and vary viewpoint, mood, or functional emphasis while preserving the same authored identity.
